title: SkillsBridge assessment desk

scope.method: Source inspection; browser review artifacts are maintained separately.
scope.publication: Local prototype; this file does not establish deployed hosting.

motion.value: Animations and transitions disabled; automatic scrolling.

surfaceBehavior.evidence: Up to 12 inline disclosure editors with category, title, source text, optional source URL and removal. Adding focuses the title; removal returns focus to Add evidence.
surfaceBehavior.imports: GitHub README text and a keyboard-operable local text file trigger. Source text is student supplied; ownership/code/deployment are not verified. Files limited to 96 KB and 24000 characters; binary NUL rejected.
surfaceBehavior.syntheticExample: Loading the example reveals a persistent synthetic notice. Edits preserve synthetic_example provenance in submission. Example reports repeat the disclosure.
surfaceBehavior.evaluation: Automatic, Offline text scan and Semantic LLM choices. Explicit semantic choice is rejected when not configured. Connection, evaluator capability and model availability have separate labels.
surfaceBehavior.processing: Queued/processing live text; polling every 1400ms; manual Check status after timeout or request error. Busy submission is disabled.
surfaceBehavior.report: Inline report with evaluator badge, readiness reason, artifact summaries, textual experience tiers and reasons, optional source quotes, findings and next steps. First artifact is open. Rendering focuses report h2 and announces completion.
surfaceBehavior.review: Inline review note saved to the workspace; UI explicitly states no notification is sent.
surfaceBehavior.history: Name search, refresh, report reopening/status polling, native delete confirmation.
surfaceBehavior.modelLab: Awaiting-labels state plus conditional experimental-model data rendering. No available replacement model or measured accuracy is established by these conditional UI branches.
surfaceBehavior.integration: Endpoint list, origin-specific Python/httpx sample, clipboard copy, API docs/schema/health links.
surfaceBehavior.workspaceAccess: Native modal accepts optional API key stored in page memory only. Provider credentials are server-side. One shared workspace, not a multiuser login.
surfaceBehavior.responsiveCaveat: Mobile hides the sidebar profile/settings entry; workspace access is reachable from API & integration.

truthBoundary: No validated trained replacement readiness model established.
Offline scanning is not semantic quality judgement or ability verification.
Evidence support is distinct from independent verification.

narrative.overview:
A clear reading surface, compact navigation, evidence arranged as a ledger, and an inline report. This is the shipped Operate-mode prototype: the student's source material carries the visual interest. White working surfaces sit on a quiet near-white canvas, with ink typography and restrained green states.

This document refreshes the existing direction contract against `prototype/static/index.html`, `style.css`, and `app.js`. It describes the implemented interface, not validated model performance or a published service. Durable product truth remains in PRODUCT.md; surface behavior and implementation extensions are recorded in `.impeccable/surfaces/assessment-desk.json`.
keyCharacteristics: Evidence and uncertainty remain readable together.
Complete quiet borders define flat working surfaces.
Inline editing and expansion keep source context close.
Small, functional state changes respect reduced motion.

rules.name: The Status Truth Rule
rules.body: Green connection status means the workspace connected; evaluator capability and readiness-model status remain separate labelled facts.

dos: Do keep source quotations, uncertainty, and evidence status close to findings.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and native disclosure/dialog behavior.
Do distinguish synthetic examples, offline scanning, semantic assessment, and model availability.
Do use flat bordered working surfaces and reserve shadows for dialogs and toasts.
donts: Don't add fabricated accuracy, readiness percentages, decorative charts, or score rings.
Don't replace evidence with stock imagery, glass effects, or background gradients.
Don't imply that a review request sends a notification or that workspace access is a multiuser login.
Don't claim real labels, a trained replacement model, configured live provider credentials, or published hosting from this UI.
